narrative:
Fayette County has 16,857 registered voters, with 14.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 48.4%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 14.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.8% of registrants.
